Walk it

Before you start

  • You need step 3.2 (Run MRP); step 3.5 (Run MRP); step 1.2 (Preflight).

Steps

Screen
Warehousing➔Manager Dashboard whinh2300m000

Why LN works this way. The sales order from Create the demand is released to warehousing, advised, picked, frozen and confirmed, exactly as in Ship from stock. On-hand at the shipping warehouse down by the shipped quantity is the completion test for the whole chain.

StepActionYou should see
7.1In the sales order, Actions➔Release➔Release to Warehousing… per steps 2–5 (Release to warehousing)Log Report prints; a warehousing order exists under your sales order number
7.2In Warehouse Manager Dashboard whinh2300m000, filter on your sales order number and Drill InWarehousing Order whinh2100m100, Origin Sales, Type 20- SO/SC Out
7.3On the Outbound Lines tab, tick the line and run Actions➔Advice➔Generate AdviceAdvised and Released both fill; Picking List by Location prints
7.4In Picking List whinh4525m100, tick the line
7.5Run Actions➔Pick RunLine status Staged
7.6Read Shipment on the order's Shipment Lines tabWrite downshipment number
7.7In Shipments whinh4130m000, find the shipment and Drill In, then Actions➔FreezeStatus = Frozen; Confirm becomes available
7.8Actions➔ConfirmWrite downshipped quantity; Status = Confirmed, inventory relieved
7.9Re-read BAM-CHOP-PAIR on-hand at the warehouse from step 1.2 (Preflight)Write downpair on-hand after shippingdown by exactly the shipped quantity

If something goes wrong

SymptomWhat to do
Advice greyed outYou are on the session toolbar. The advice actions live on the Outbound Lines toolbar — step 7.3
The order will not adviseThe header Warehouse does not hold the stock. Recheck against step 1.2 (Preflight)
The shipment will not confirmThe line was never picked, or the shipment was never frozen. Steps 7.6 and 7.7

Plan to shipment
Ship

  1. In the sales order, choose Release to Warehousing… per steps 2–5 of Release to warehousing

    Actions➔Release➔Release to Warehousing…

    You should see

    Log Report prints; a warehousing order exists under your sales order number

  2. In Warehouse Manager Dashboard, filter on your sales order number and Drill In

    You should see

    Warehousing Order whinh2100m100, Origin Sales, Type 20- SO/SC Out

  3. On the Outbound Lines tab, tick the line and run Generate Advice

    Actions➔Advice➔Generate Advice

    You should see

    Advised and Released both fill; Picking List by Location prints

  4. In Picking List, tick the line

  5. Run Pick Run

    Actions➔Pick Run

    You should see

    Line status Staged

  6. Read Shipment on the order's Shipment Lines tab

    Write down

    shipment number

  7. In Shipments, find the shipment and Drill In, then Freeze

    Actions➔Freeze

    You should see

    Status = Frozen; Confirm becomes available

  8. Choose Confirm

    Actions➔Confirm

    Write down

    shipped quantity; Status = Confirmed, inventory relieved

  9. Re-read BAM-CHOP-PAIR on-hand at the warehouse from step 2 of Preflight

    Write down

    pair on-hand after shipping — down by exactly the shipped quantity

This task starts at Warehousing➔Manager Dashboard whinh2300m000

    • Advice greyed out

      You are on the session toolbar. The advice actions live on the Outbound Lines toolbar — step 3

    • The order will not advise

      The header Warehouse does not hold the stock. Recheck against step 2 of Preflight

    • The shipment will not confirm

      The line was never picked, or the shipment was never frozen. Steps 6 and 7

  • The sales order from Create the demand is released to warehousing, advised, picked, frozen and confirmed, exactly as in Ship from stock. On-hand at the shipping warehouse down by the shipped quantity is the completion test for the whole chain.
